releaseNotes:
• AutoCAD-style Dimensioning Tool: 2-point extension selection with real-time rubber-band and dynamic offset dragging
• 1-Click Wall Auto-Dimensioning: Hover and click any wall to immediately drag out full-length dimensions
• Interactive Dimension Grips: Select existing dimensions to dynamically adjust offset distance
• High-performance 60 FPS live dimension preview and crosshair cursor feedback
• Multi-platform release packages (Windows Setup .exe, Windows Portable .zip, Linux .tar.gz, macOS .app .zip)
